summary: Specifies how authors of RFCs in the IAB stream grant the community rights to copy and use their text, and what rights readers get. It asks the IETF Trust to manage them. It is informational.

eli5.summary: Like the matching rules for independent authors, this document says what everyone may do with the text of RFCs written by the Internet Architecture Board.

questions: what are the rights rules for iab stream rfcs
